description.value: The Beach Gardens Beer & Wine Store is a retail cold-beer and wine shop situated at the Beach Gardens Resort & Marina on Powell River's waterfront at Grief Point on the Sunshine Coast. It sits within a full-service marina and resort complex that also houses the award-winning Seasider Bistro, an on-site distillery, and overnight accommodation. For touring cyclists on the Sunshine Coast route, it is a convenient cold-beverage resupply stop with on-site washrooms and a restaurant steps away.

address.value: 7074 Westminster Street, Powell River, BC V8A 1C5

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record names a beer and wine retail store; the website contact page explicitly confirms 'Beach Gardens Beer & Wine Store Hours: 10am – 9pm Daily', verifying the store is operational and correctly named. Address and phone were absent in OSM but clearly stated on the website (7074 Westminster Street, Powell River BC V8A 1C5; 604-485-6267). Washrooms are confirmed via the marina amenities page ('washrooms, showers, laundry facilities'), and the store is described as 'located at the marina'; no bike parking or water-refill evidence appears anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM had no address or phone; both were sourced solely from the website (7074 Westminster Street, Powell River BC V8A 1C5; 604-485-6267) — contact_confirmed set to null accordingly.

The marina page refers to the store as 'Cold Beer & Wine Store' while the OSM record and the contact page both use 'Beach Gardens Beer & Wine Store' — minor internal name inconsistency on the same website.
The website URL belongs to the parent Beach Gardens Resort & Marina; there is no dedicated page for the beer & wine store, so amenity detail for the store specifically is limited.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Confirmed operational retail beer and wine store within a well-established resort and marina complex on a key Sunshine Coast cycling route, offering cold-beverage resupply and on-site washrooms for touring cyclists.
